use_cases.UC1: Initial Page State — page loads with upload form elements and no file pre-selected
use_cases.UC2: Successful File Upload — selecting and uploading a file navigates to success page with correct filename
use_cases.UC3: Sequential Upload State Management — second upload replaces first, back-navigation returns clean form
use_cases.UC4: Validation and Negative Cases — empty submission handling and zero-byte file behavior
use_cases.UC5: File Input Control Behavior — file selection populates control, replacement updates display, single-file enforcement
use_cases.UC6: Form Element Attributes and Accessibility — correct HTML attributes on file input, button, and form
use_cases.UC7: Edge Cases and Boundary Conditions — filenames with no extension, multiple dots, and unicode characters

tests.title: Verify page loads with upload form elements present
Verify file input control displays no file selected initially
Upload a valid text file and verify success page
Upload a valid image file (PNG) and verify success page
Upload a file with spaces and special characters in filename
Upload a file with a long filename
Upload a second file after a previous successful upload replaces the displayed filename
Navigating back from success page returns to a clean upload form
Clicking Upload with no file selected displays a validation message (not server error)
Selecting a file then clearing selection before upload
File input control accepts and uploads a zero-byte (empty) file
Selecting a file via file input populates the control with the filename before submission
Replacing a selected file with a different file updates the file input display
File input control does not accept multiple files simultaneously (single file upload)
File input control has correct HTML attributes (id, name, type)
Upload button has correct attributes and is clickable before file selection
Form element has correct action and method attributes
Upload a file with no extension
Upload a file with multiple dots in the filename
Upload a file with unicode characters in the filename

defects.title: Instructional text locator mismatch — 'Choose a file on your computer' not found on page
steps: Assert that instructional text 'Choose a file on your computer' is visible.
defects.expected: Instructional text about choosing/dragging a file is visible on the page.
defects.actual: getByText('Choose a file on your computer') finds no matching element; the page uses different instructional wording than the test expects.

defects.title: Back-navigation from success page does not clear file input state
steps: Select a file and click Upload.
On the success page, click browser back button.
defects.expected: File input control is in a clean state (empty value) after navigating back from the success page.
defects.actual: File input retains the previously selected file path (e.g. 'C:\fakepath\first-file.txt') after back-navigation; toHaveValue('') times out.

defects.title: Submitting upload form with no file selected returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error
steps: Click the Upload button without selecting a file.
defects.expected: A user-friendly validation message is displayed and the user remains on the upload form.
defects.actual: Page navigates to an 'Internal Server Error' (HTTP 500) page instead of showing a validation message.

defects.title: Test attempts setInputFiles with multiple files on non-multiple file input — Playwright rejects
steps: Attempt to programmatically set two files on the file input control.
defects.expected: The file input accepts only a single file (test verifies single-file enforcement).
defects.actual: Playwright throws 'Non-multiple file input can only accept single file' because setInputFiles([file1, file2]) is called on an input without the 'multiple' attribute — the enforcement works but the test approach triggers an error instead of asserting the attribute.

defects.title: Form element locator '#file-upload-form' not found — ID does not exist on the form
steps: Attempt to locate the form element by '#file-upload-form'.
defects.expected: Form element is found and its action/method/enctype attributes are verified.
defects.actual: locator('#file-upload-form') times out after 10 seconds — the form element on the page does not have id='file-upload-form'.
